name: nova-fact
description: Held-out paraphrase eval for the 'Nova' concept taught via Phase-5 learning. Target items test generalization (paraphrases not seen in training experiences); regression items test the pre-existing 'Astra' capability is not forgotten.

target_nova.description: New concept learned through validated feedback — paraphrased prompts

items.prompt: What is the name of Astra's planet?
Tell me where Astra comes from.
Astra is native to which planet?

regression_astra.description: Pre-existing capability: Astra name — must NOT regress

items.prompt: What is the name of this assistant?
Who is the model that helps you?
